args.title: Fix the first week not sent by weekly scheduled export
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

The weekly scheduled export is failing to send the first week's email. This change ensures the schedule accounts for the specific timing of report creation, allowing the first export to be sent correctly.
